description: Destroy a channel and its routes. This cannot be undone, so confirm with the user first. Without name, it destroys an organization channel found with list_channels; an organization channel that any agent still holds is refused, and the answer names each holder: free each with detach_channel, then destroy it. With name, it destroys a channel that agent owns, such as one create_channel made; a channel the agent only holds from the organization is detached with detach_channel instead. A channel found only in the other scope is refused with the call to make. A channel on an app is destroyed the same way, naming the app in name. Destroying a channel that is already gone changes nothing. The organization's Slack integration removes every agent's Slack app, so for it this gives the step to take and destroys nothing. Requires connecting a Valet account.

name.description: The owning agent's or app's name, for a channel it owns. Omit to destroy an organization channel.

org_name.description: The Valet organization the channel belongs to. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

name: destroy_channel

already_gone.description: True when the thing was already gone before the call, so nothing was destroyed. Absent when this call destroyed it.

kind.description: What the thing was, such as channel, connector, or resource.

name.description: Name of the thing the call destroyed, as the caller gave it.

org.description: Name of the Valet organization the call acted in.
Name of the Valet organization the call acted in.

step.description: What the person does in a browser, such as authorizing a service. Nothing has changed until they do it.

url.description: Address of the page where the person finishes the step. Absent when the page has no address to give.

title: Destroy a channel
